posts.text: I'm thrilled to announce that I'll be interning with Intuit this summer as a Software Engineer intern at the Toronto Office! I want to express my sincere gratitude to my recruiters Noora Ali, and Justin McCauley for their support throughout the hiring process. 😊 I am excited to begin my role with the remarkable team at Intuit TurboTax and anticipate tackling fresh challenges and a summer filled with learning. #IntuitInterns2024 #SummerAtIntuit #NewBeginningsAtIntuit #IncomingIntuitIntern
